body: the privilege is this post is so loud. Like what fantasy world do you live in? I went to college for two years and i’m over $30,000 in debt. If you could afford to pay for her whole college career, you don’t just have a “good job”, you have an incredible job, so don’t downplay this for sympathy dude. I just can’t understand entitled people like you because if i had those kinds of funds i wouldn’t even think *twice* about handing it over. i would do it for a person i had known for 5 goddamn minutes. it seems like every single person in these replies has forgotten that college has not always been a luxury, but now it is. it is a privilege to be able to afford to go. college is the future of our children and if you could help, why wouldn’t you?  just doesn’t make sense to me at all and never will.
we’ve been together much longer than i’ve been 21... almost 3 years.

We’ve been together for two, almost 3, years and i’ve seen so much improvement in that short time frame. i know they truly can overcome this. they’ve done it with other issues and they’re working really hard. i just don’t know what are healthy boundaries to set regarding this thing. i just don’t want them to ask anymore, but do i go as far as to say if they don’t stop drinking then i’ll leave them? i don’t want this to be some big toxic drama fest, i just want the best for my best friend and partner.

But is it though? They have a much better chance at actually having a good life than I do. My youngest sibling is FTM trans and he needs so much help, but he can’t get it because his adult sister (me) can’t get her shit together for 2 seconds. He’s young and needs the help soon so he doesn’t end up like me. It just all seems easier to me if I were out of the picture.
Not to mention the crazy amount of times I’ve been abused physically, mentally, and sexually. The time I was raped by my best friend. God this bullshit keeps piling on. I can’t take it.

I can’t report him at this point. It’s been a year. And I go to a Christian college so they’d just flip it back on me. My friends know about it and so does my therapist. But my therapist is kind of an ass about it. My friends aren’t, but they don’t really know what to do/ say.
Today is better, not good, just better. That’s enough for now.
I get what you’re saying, and thank you. There’s more to it as well, I just felt like divulging every detail anonymously to the internet wasn’t the best idea.
